text.1: You walk into a big forest.
text.2: You walk into a big, green forest. The trees look magic!
text.3: You step into the Enchanted Forest. The trees are tall and green, and a soft light glows between them.
text.4: You step into the Enchanted Forest, where the trees are tall and the air smells like pine. A soft, golden light glows between the branches, and somewhere nearby a bird is singing.

text.2: You find red berries. Yum! You put some in your bag.
text.3: You find a bush full of red berries. They taste sweet, and you tuck some into your bag for later.
text.4: Behind a mossy log you find a bush full of plump red berries. They taste sweet and juicy, and you tuck a handful into your bag for later.

feedback.3: Your tummy is full and you feel strong.

text.2: The path splits in two. One way has a bridge. One way has paw prints.
text.3: The path splits in two. One way leads to a wobbly bridge. The other has little paw prints in the mud.
text.4: Ahead, the path splits in two. To the left, a wobbly wooden bridge crosses a sparkling stream. To the right, a trail of tiny paw prints winds into the ferns.

text.2: The bridge wobbles and creaks. Oh no!
text.3: The wooden bridge wobbles and creaks under your feet. The water below is sparkling.
text.4: The old wooden bridge wobbles and creaks with every step. Far below, the stream sparkles, and a few silver fish dart between the rocks.

feedback.3: Step by step, you make it across.
Splash! You slip and get soaked, but you laugh and keep going.

text.2: You find a little fox. It looks lost and sad.
text.3: At the end of the trail you find a little fox. It is lost, and its tail is drooping.
text.4: At the end of the trail, curled under a fern, you find a little fox. It is lost, and its fluffy tail is drooping low.

feedback.3: The fox hops into your arms. You have a new friend!

text.1: A big tree is asleep. It blocks the path.
text.2: A giant tree is asleep on the path. It is a Treant! It blocks the way.
text.3: A giant tree lies asleep across the path. It is a Treant, and it is snoring so loudly that the leaves shake.
text.4: Across the path lies a giant tree with a sleepy, wrinkled face. It is a Treant, snoring so loudly that the leaves rattle, and its branches block the whole way.

feedback.3: The Treant opens one eye and smiles. "A friend!" it says.
Shh! You sneak around, but a snack falls out of your bag.

text.1: Who was asleep on the path?
text.2: Who was asleep on the path?
text.3: Who was asleep across the path?
text.4: Who was snoring across the path in the forest?

feedback.3: That's right. It was a Treant!
Not quite. Think about the big tree.
Not quite. Think about the big tree.

text.1: You rest by a fire. Now you feel better!
text.2: Your friend helps you to a cozy fire. You rest, and now you feel better!
text.3: Your travel friend helps you to a cozy campfire. You rest and eat a warm snack, and soon you feel strong again.
text.4: Your travel friend helps you to a cozy campfire. You rest, eat a warm snack, and listen to the crackling logs until you feel strong again.

text.1: You did it! Crystal Caverns is next!
text.2: You made it through the forest! The Crystal Caverns are next.
text.3: You made it through the Enchanted Forest! Ahead, a cave glitters. The Crystal Caverns are next.
text.4: You made it through the Enchanted Forest! Beyond the last tree, a cave mouth glitters with colored light. The Crystal Caverns are your next stop.
